g.text: LLM knowledge reaches a ranker in two forms
an embedding for retrieval (GSU) and learnable semantic IDs for ranking (ESU).
Better embeddings mattered more than the quantizer
the V2 embeddings made codes 15× less crowded before FSQ was added.
collision rate and items-per-SID are cheap diagnostics worth reporting.
Strong in production, thin in ablation
large online gains, but which component buys them is not shown.
